<style>
.mw-ability-start{

.mw-ability-start:before{

.mw-subline{

}
.mw-stage{

.mw-ring-a{

  height:min(72vh,650px);
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(66deg) rotateZ(20deg);
  box-shadow:0 0 38px rgba(194,184,255,.16);
}
.mw-ring-b{
  width:min(54vh,490px);
  height:min(54vh,490px);
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(74deg) rotateZ(-35deg);

.mw-ring-c{

}
.mw-code{

  align-items:center;
  min-height:13px;
  color:var(--mw-cyan);
  font:800 11px/1 "Inter","Arial",sans-serif;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  font-feature-settings:"tnum";
  letter-spacing:3.5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.mw-name{
  margin:0;
  max-width:330px;
  min-height:34px;

  font-size:34px;

  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.mw-divider{

  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  margin:10px 0 8px;
}
.mw-divider:before,.mw-divider:after{

  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(221,216,255,.38),transparent);
}

}
.mw-detail{

  color:var(--mw-soft);
}
.mw-tags{

  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:7px;
  min-height:26px;
  margin:10px 0 10px;
}
.mw-tags span{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:22px;
  padding:2px 9px;
  color:#f7f4ff;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.13),rgba(157,234,255,.06)),
    rgba(8,8,22,.48);
  border:1px solid rgba(221,216,255,.34);
  font:800 12px/1 "Inter","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;

  box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.mw-switch{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr) 46px;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  min-height:50px;
  padding:5px 9px;
  border:1px solid rgba(222,216,255,.28);
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(255,255,255,.02)),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 18px,rgba(224,219,255,.08) 19px,transparent 20px);
  margin-top:auto;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.mw-nav,.mw-confirm{
  appearance:none;
  border:0;
  color:var(--mw-ink);
  cursor:pointer;
  font-family:inherit;
}
.mw-nav{
  width:42px;
  height:42px;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;

    linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.18),rgba(130,118,226,.14)),

  border-color:#fff;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,.12),0 0 28px rgba(205,198,255,.34);
}
.mw-page{
  min-width:0;
  height:38px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:48px 14px 48px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  justify-items:center;
  column-gap:6px;
  color:var(--mw-soft);
  font:900 18px/1 "Inter","Arial",sans-serif;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  font-feature-settings:"tnum";

}
.mw-page strong{

  align-items:center;

.mw-page i{

  height:30px;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:800;

}
.mw-page span{

  height:30px;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:1px;
  color:#fff;
  text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.56);
}
.mw-steps{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(13,1fr);
  align-items:center;
  justify-items:center;

  min-height:24px;
  padding:0 2px 7px;
  margin-bottom:6px;

}
.mw-steps:before{
  display:none;
}
.mw-step{
  position:relative;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  background:transparent;
  border:0;
  border-radius:0;
  clip-path:none;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .25s ease;
}
.mw-step:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:50%;
  width:12px;
  height:12px;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg);

  background:rgba(10,10,27,.25);
  border:1px dashed rgba(232,228,255,.56);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  transition:background .25s ease,border-color .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease,transform .25s ease;
}
.mw-step:after{
  display:none;
}
.mw-step.active{
  background:transparent;
  box-shadow:none;
  transform:translateY(-1px);
}
.mw-step.active:before{

  height:14px;

  box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.92),0 0 18px rgba(157,234,255,.76),0 0 30px rgba(169,157,255,.5);
}
.mw-step.active:after{
  display:none;
}
.mw-confirm{
  width:100%;
  min-height:38px;
  padding:8px 16px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(218,214,255,.92) 55%,rgba(151,138,255,.86)),

  color:#070713;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  clip-path:polygon(14px 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 14px) 100%,0 100%);

  letter-spacing:4px;

  transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease;

}
.mw-confirm:hover{
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(217,211,255,.5),inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.36);
}
.mw-confirm:before,.mw-confirm:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:50%;
  width:34px;
  height:1px;
  background:#080817;
  opacity:.4;
}
.mw-confirm:before{left:18px;}
.mw-confirm:after{right:18px;}
.mw-fade{
  opacity:1;
  transform:translateY(0);
  transition:opacity .24s ease,transform .24s ease;
}
.mw-fade.is-out{
  opacity:0;
  transform:translateY(8px);
}
@keyframes mw-orbit{
  from{transform:rotate(0deg);}
  to{transform:rotate(360deg);}
}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .mw-ability-start{
    min-width:0;
    height:auto;
    min-height:720px;
    flex-direction:column;
  }
  .mw-head{
    left:18px;
    top:20px;
    width:calc(100% - 36px);
  }
  .mw-kicker{
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:2.5px;
  }
  .mw-kicker:before,.mw-kicker:after{width:24px;}
  .mw-sigil{
    width:46px;
    height:46px;
  }
  .mw-cn{
    font-size:30px;
    letter-spacing:2px;
  }
  .mw-subline{
    margin-left:62px;
    width:220px;
  }
  .mw-stage{
    min-height:340px;
    padding:96px 14px 4px;
  }
  .mw-canvas{
    width:min(84vw,360px);
    height:min(84vw,360px);
  }
  .mw-panel{
    width:100%;
    padding:0 14px 18px;
  }
  .mw-panel-inner{
    padding:18px 16px 16px;
  }
  .mw-name{
    font-size:30px;
    max-width:280px;
  }
  .mw-desc{
    font-size:13px;
    line-height:1.6;
    min-height:78px;
  }
  .mw-switch{
    gap:8px;
  }
  .mw-nav{
    width:38px;
    height:38px;
  }
}
</style>
